en: The image shows a hand-colored vintage postcard depicting an ornate pavilion or colonnade surrounded by trees and greenery, with a few people dressed in early 20th-century attire. The structure has elaborate woodwork and glass windows. The text on the postcard references 'Marienbad' and 'Rudolfsquelle,' suggesting a famous spa or spring. The area around the building is park-like and well-kept.
